transcription.text: Page 71, unit 8. What do our grandparents do?
Page 72. Get ready.
A. Listen, then point and say.
1. Grandma Goo and Grandpa Wong always go shopping together.
2. Grandma Goo and Grandpa Wong like going for a walk in the park.
3. I sometimes help my Grandpa use the internet.
4. My grandparents like doing exercise every day.
5. Where is my Grandma? She is doing housework in the kitchen.

Page 74, explore. Our Grandparents
I'm Jun Jun. My sister and I are at our Grandparents' house for a week.
Our Grandparents don't work now. Every morning they go for a walk in
the park.
They often do Tai Chi with their friends there. Grandpa and Grandma do
Tai Chi in the park.
It's Sunday morning. Grandma and I are in the supermarket. She always
goes shopping on Sundays. Grandma and I go shopping.
In the afternoon Grandpa usually does gardening. He has lots of plants.
They look great. Grandpa likes gardening.
In the evening Grandma shows us her food vlog. Lots of people watch it.
Grandma has a food vlog.
You are Sunday. Page 77
In spring it's warm and sunny. We walk in the park. In summer it gets
hot. We stay at home a lot.
In autumn the leaves change colour. We go for a long bike ride. In
winter it gets cold. I visit my Grandparents' farm.
I bring a gift for Grandma, a sweater, to keep her warm.

I buy gifts for my Grandparents.
You do a lot of things with your Grandparents. He takes photos of us.
She takes photos of us. It gets warm in spring.
We see a moon in the sky. They see a moon in the sky.
Then say... Grandpa, may I ask you some questions? Where do you often
go? I often go to the supermarket with your Grandma.
What do you do with your friends, Grandpa? I go to the park and take
photos with Grandpa Lee. I see. And I like sport. I often do Tai Chi
with my friends. That's great!
Page 80
This is a famous poem about the Double Ninth Festival. On this day,
families climb mountains together. They drink flour tea and eat Chongyang
cakes.
People also visit their parents or grandparents. They bring them gifts
and help them at home. Then they have a family dinner.
